_about: CNC and panel terms in every language. Every catalog uses these words for these concepts. pt is European Portuguese (ecrã, ficheiro, guardar, definições, registo, paragem); zh is Simplified Chinese; ja uses polite です/ます in sentences and short nouns on buttons. G-code words (G54, M3), axis letters, units (mm, in, mm/min, rpm), MDI, STEP, INI, HAL, LinuxCNC and CoffeeCNC stay as they are.

style.en: Buttons: imperative verbs (Save settings). Sentences end with a period.
style.fr: vous; buttons infinitive (Enregistrer); narrow no-break space U+202F before : ; ? ! and inside « »; apostrophe ’.
style.de: Sie; buttons infinitive (Speichern); touch screen: tippen, not klicken; nouns capitalized; „…“ quotes.
style.es: usted; buttons infinitive (Guardar); touch: pulse/toque; opening ¿ ¡.
style.pt: European Portuguese, você-less impersonal or imperative (Toque, Guarde); buttons infinitive (Guardar).
style.zh: Full-width punctuation (，。：？); no space between Chinese and digits is fine, keep a space before units after numbers as in English.
style.ja: Full-width punctuation (、。：？); sentences in です/ます; buttons as nouns or 〜する verbs (保存, 適用).
